entities.summary: National park from the approximately 45 kilometer long section of the krka river between knin and skradin and the lower reaches of the tributary čikolain in croatia Originating c. 1985 CE. Krka National Park is a protected area, arising around 1985. A moderately significant entity in the historical record.
